summary.business_type: Local Service Business (Home & Commercial Cleaning / SAB / Brick-and-Mortar)
top_findings: Missing poster attribute on index.html hero background video causes potential LCP delay on slower mobile connections.
Meta descriptions on index.html (245 chars) and contact.html (212 chars) exceed Google's 160-char display snippet limit.
Image formats are standard JPG/PNG; converting to WebP/AVIF can reduce payload by 40-60%.
Title tag on about.html (80 chars) exceeds the 70-character threshold for desktop SERP snippets.
No security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options) configured at server/hosting level yet.
quick_wins: Add poster='/kitchen-clean.jpg' to hero video in index.html for instant perceived LCP.
Trim meta descriptions on homepage and contact page to 155 characters with prominent phone/call-to-action.
Add explicit width and height attributes to logo and header icons to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
Trim about.html title tag to 'About Lady T's Cleaning Services | Benin City Cleaners'.
Ensure web server sends Cache-Control: max-age=31536000 for static images and video assets.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Robots.txt is fully configured and allows standard crawlers plus AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).
XML Sitemap is well-formed with lastmod dates and accurate priority levels across all 5 routes.
Canonical tags are strictly defined with absolute HTTPS URLs across all pages.
Valid HTML5 semantics and responsive viewport meta tag implemented on all pages.
Zero broken internal links detected across the entire site architecture.

findings.title: Security Headers Configuration
findings.description: Production server configuration should include HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, and X-Content-Type-Options headers upon live deployment.
findings.recommendation: Configure response headers in web server (Nginx/Apache/Cloudflare/Vercel) config.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Strong local authority with real neighborhood names (GRA, Ugbowo, Airport Rd, Sapele Rd, Amagba).
Transparent pricing guides and comprehensive service tier comparisons in blog.html.
Clear satisfaction guarantee (100% Sparkle Satisfaction Guarantee with free immediate re-clean).
Vetted and background-checked staff credentials highlighted across copy.

findings.title: Expand Blog Post Articles into Dedicated Sub-Pages
findings.description: Currently, blog guides reside as anchor sections (#cost-guide, #deep-vs-regular) on a single blog.html page. Splitting top guides into dedicated URLs (e.g. /blog/house-cleaning-cost-benin-city.html) will capture high-volume long-tail search intent.
findings.recommendation: Create dedicated blog post pages for the top 3 highest-intent guides with targeted Schema BlogPosting.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single H1 tag per page strictly maintained across all 5 pages.
Rich keyword targeting in titles and headers aligned with Target Keyword Strategy docx.
Strong internal linking between Home, Services, About, Blog, and Contact with descriptive anchor text.
High-converting CTAs (Book Online, WhatsApp Instant Quote, Telephone Direct) prominently placed.

findings.title: Meta Description Length Truncation
findings.description: Homepage meta description is 245 characters; Contact page is 212 characters. Google typically truncates at 155-160 characters on desktop and ~120 on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Front-load primary keywords and phone numbers into the first 150 characters.

findings.title: About Page Title Tag Length
findings.description: about.html title tag is 80 characters, which may truncate in Google SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to under 65 characters while preserving core brand and location keywords.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: CleaningService & LocalBusiness dual-typing in JSON-LD on index.html, about.html, and contact.html.
FAQPage schema with 6 practical Q&As eligible for rich result accordion snippets.
ItemList schema with 6 discrete Service entities on services.html.
Blog & BlogPosting structured data on blog.html.
Verified NAP (Name, Address, Phone), geo coordinates, Google Maps CID, opening hours, and sameAs social profiles across schemas.
Zero JSON syntax errors or schema validation warnings.

findings.title: AggregateRating Integration
findings.description: Consider adding AggregateRating schema referencing verified Google Reviews count once 20+ reviews are collected on Google Business Profile.
findings.recommendation: Connect verified GBP rating into the schema markup.

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Modern CSS architecture without heavyweight frameworks.
Lazy loading enabled on all below-the-fold content images.
Google Fonts preconnected with dns-prefetch.
Touch-friendly button tap targets (min 44px) and fluid typography.

findings.title: Hero Video Poster Attribute Missing
findings.description: Hero video player lacks a poster attribute. Browsers may show a black/blank frame before decoding the MP4, hurting Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).

findings.title: Hero Video Asset File Size
findings.description: hero-video.mp4 is 3.78MB. While high quality, serving a compressed 720p version (1-1.5MB) for mobile viewports will drastically improve mobile load times.
findings.recommendation: Provide responsive video source tags or compress for mobile.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO/AEO)
what_works: llms.txt file accurately implemented with Markdown specifications and structured entity data.
Permissive robots.txt explicitly authorizing GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, and ClaudeBot.
Direct quotation-ready answers to service pricing, location, dispatch times, and guarantee terms.
Clear entity disambiguation associating Lady T's Cleaning Services with Benin City, Edo State.

findings.title: services.md Deep Context Extension
findings.description: Keep services.md updated with package price bands as pricing evolves.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of images have descriptive, keyword-rich alt attributes (0 missing alt tags).
High-definition photography representing authentic cleaning services in Benin City.
New official brand logo and multi-resolution favicon suite successfully deployed.

findings.title: Modern Next-Gen Image Formats (WebP/AVIF)
findings.description: Several images in /public are saved as standard JPG (~700KB - 1MB each). Converting them to WebP will reduce image payload by 50-70% with identical visual fidelity.
findings.recommendation: Convert content photos to .webp and use <picture> elements.

phases.name: Phase 1: Quick Fixes (Immediate)
items: Add poster='/kitchen-clean.jpg' to hero video in index.html to protect Largest Contentful Paint.
Trim homepage meta description from 245 to 155 characters so the telephone and value prop display in full on mobile SERPs.
Trim contact.html meta description to 155 characters highlighting immediate WhatsApp response.
Shorten about.html title tag from 80 to 65 characters.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Optimizations
items: Compress and optimize content images to WebP format to save 3-4MB of total site weight.
Optimize hero background video to create a lighter mobile variation (<1.5MB).
Ensure production host serves gzip/brotli compression and 1-year Cache-Control headers on static assets.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority Scaling
items: Break out key blog topics into standalone sub-pages (e.g. /cleaning-cost-benin-city.html) for deep organic capture.
Collect and link verified Google Business Profile customer reviews to activate AggregateRating schema.
Submit sitemap.xml to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools once live domain DNS is connected.

phases.name: Phase 4: Ongoing Monitoring
items: Monitor keyword rankings for 'cleaning services in benin city' and 'cleaners near me'.
Track Core Web Vitals field data in Google Search Console.
Refresh llms.txt and sitemap.xml when new seasonal packages or pricing updates occur.
